progress.pair:
On the clock, press and hold HELIOS, choose "Pair with HA (code)" and enter the code:

**{code}**

The code is valid for {minutes} min.

abort.timeout: The clock did not connect while the code was valid.
abort.reconfigured: The clock was already added; its pairing has been refreshed.

init.title: Clock appearance
init.description: These settings apply to this clock only. The photo is stored privately in Home Assistant and fetched by the clock once it has signed in.

data.sendspin_url: Sendspin address (empty = derived from the Music Assistant address)
data.music_url: Music Assistant address for the clock (empty = the address the server reports)
data.music_token: Music Assistant token for the clock (empty = the integration mints its own, which a Music Assistant add-on does not allow)
data.idle_seconds: Show it after this much quiet
data.dark_exit: Lit at or above this light level
data.notifications_block: A visible warning tile keeps the panel awake

upload.title: Background photo
upload.description: JPEG or PNG up to 10 MB. The photo is resized to 1600x960 and its metadata (EXIF, GPS) is stripped.

error.no_image: There is no stored photo - upload one or pick a colour.
error.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
error.unsupported_format: Only JPEG and PNG are supported.
error.image_too_large: The image has too many pixels (max 24 million, 8192 per side).
error.corrupt_image: The image could not be read.
error.invalid_url: The Music Assistant address must start with http:// or https://, the Sendspin address with ws:// or wss://, and the diagnostics address with http:// or https://.
error.dark_exit_too_low: The light level that wakes the panel must be higher than the one that dims it: the gap between them is what keeps the screen from flickering.

no_music.title: {name} has no music
no_music.description:
Music Assistant is running, but the clock **{name}** could not get a Music Assistant token, so it cannot play music or appear as a player. A Music Assistant add-on does not let the integration create one.

In Music Assistant create a long-lived token, then paste it into this clock's options (Settings > Devices & services > Helios > Configure) in the Music Assistant token field. Clocks paired later reuse a pasted token automatically.
